title: JustTitanium
description: A minecraft mod that (just) adds titanium to minecraft!
body:
# JustTitanium

JustTitanium is a simple Minecraft mod that adds Titanium to the game. 

Working with: Minecraft Java 1.21.11

<iframe width="1374" height="773" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2Z3Dk7VxmbQ" title="JustTitanium; Just a minecraft mod that adds titanium to the game!" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

Of course this mod has some features!

1. `Titanium Sword` is extra cool and has some features other swords don't have
   It does have Attack speed of 7.5 (Higher than diamond swords!)
   It also has an extreme knockback that slams mobs away from you!

2. `Raw Titanium` has an active use ability.
   Right-clicking it clears fire, removes poison, grants short fire resistance, grants haste, and puts the item on cooldown.

3. `Titanium Ore` is very VERY dangerous! (Just don't stand on it)
   Any living entity stepping on the ore is affected with slowness and weakness.

## Progression

- `Titanium Ore` generates in the Overworld.
- Mining `Titanium Ore` drops `Raw Titanium`.
- `Silk Touch` lets you collect the ore block itself.
- `Raw Titanium` smelts into `Titanium Ingot`.
- `Titanium Sword` is crafted with two `Titanium Ingot` and one `Stick`.

## Notes

- `Titanium Ore` uses iron-style loot logic for normal mining and fortune scaling.
- Smelting `Raw Titanium` takes twice as long as normal iron.
- `Titanium Sword` has an attack damage of `7.5` and `2` attack speed.
